cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand me the drawer key before I sign the club accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My signature covers the receipts too. Let me check how it adds up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put mine beside yours. Give me the key and we'll correct it together before either name goes outside this room.

reason: Remove only the added voluntary and rank clauses; the existing signature authority, receipt need and shared-risk bargain already enact the exact pair.
